name: CI - Spring Boot Test
on: pull_request: push: branches: - main - dev
jobs: test: runs-on: [self-hosted, windows] defaults: run: working-directory: synctrip
steps: - name: Checkout source uses: actions/checkout@v4
- name: Set up JDK 17 uses: actions/setup-java@v4 with: distribution: temurin java-version: '17' cache: gradle
- name: Run unit tests shell: powershell run: .\gradlew.bat clean test --no-daemon
